name: Textarea
summary: Use a textarea when users need to enter more than one line of free text.
whenToUse: Use when the expected answer may contain sentences or several lines.
Set rows to suggest a useful starting height without restricting how much users can enter.
whenNotToUse: Use a Text input for a short single-line answer.
Use Character count when a genuine, user-understood maximum length must be enforced.
Do not ask for large free-text answers when structured questions would be easier to answer and process.

anatomy.name: Form group
anatomy.description: Groups the visible label, optional hint, optional error and textarea.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: A visible label is associated using for and id.

anatomy.name: Native textarea
anatomy.description: The govuk-textarea supports multi-line input and browser resizing.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: A multi-line answer without a strict character limit.

variants.name: Error
variants.use: Redisplay an invalid answer with a linked error message.

behaviour: The base textarea requires no GOV.UK JavaScript.
Allow native resizing and retain the submitted answer after recoverable validation errors.
Validate on the server and store line breaks safely.
accessibility: Associate a visible label and reference hint and error IDs in aria-describedby.
Do not use placeholder text instead of a label or hint.
Do not disable browser resizing or clip enlarged text.
content: Ask a focused question and explain what information to include.
Say how the answer will be used when users may disclose sensitive information.
Avoid unnecessary maximum lengths; when one is necessary explain it before input.
